hectares = 10
pineapples_per_hectare = 100
months_per_year = 12
months_per_harvest = 3
harvests = months_per_year // months_per_harvest
total = hectares * pineapples_per_hectare * harvests
assert total / harvests / pineapples_per_hectare == hectares
print(total)

size = 200
rate = 2
fraction = 0.4
restart = 20
partial_time = size * fraction / rate
full_time = size / rate
total = partial_time + restart + full_time
assert (total - restart - full_time) * rate == size * fraction
print(total)

lee = 38
difference = 2
improvement = 0.10
gerald_before = lee + difference
gerald_after = gerald_before * (1 - improvement)
assert gerald_after / (1 - improvement) - difference == lee
print(gerald_after)

remaining = 5
red = 2
before_orange = remaining * 2
after_green = before_orange + red
initial = after_green * 3 // 2
assert (initial - initial / 3 - red) / 2 == remaining
print(initial)

chickens = 20
cups_per_chicken = 3
morning = 15
afternoon = 25
third = chickens * cups_per_chicken - morning - afternoon
assert (morning + afternoon + third) / chickens == cups_per_chicken
print(third)

total = 200
restaurants = 40

unused = total - restaurants * per_restaurant
